programme.title: Mystery Woman 6: Redemption
programme.desc: A rare first edition from a pioneer author goes missing in the mystery novels-specialized Kinsey bookshop during remodeling by the local firm of Tyler Dell, who recently lost his father, a Vietnam veteran. Retired English teacher Jim Carter, who overheard everything, is murdered shortly after a row in Reverend Tucker's homeless shelter Haven with aggressive lush Murphy. Rude police chief Connors isn't up to an investigation while the killer keeps sniping, so the bookstore's armchair sleuths duo does it alone, starting from a lacquered box left by Jim for his illegitimate daughter, who never even knew his name. It starts a set of cues, slowly unraveling a grim intrigue starting during a 1965 US illegal intrusion into Red Khmer territory.

programme.title: Desolation Canyon

programme.title: The Pledge/A Gunfighter's Pledge
programme.desc: Western in which a former Texan sheriff (Luke Perry) sets out to capture the escaped convict who murdered his wife and son. He runs him to earth in Mexico, and in the resulting shoot-out an innocent man is killed and his quarry gets away. Carrying the dead man back to his family, he discovers that his widowed sister and her son are under threat from an unscrupulous land baron (Thomas Howell) who wants their property for its water rights. The sheriff vows to protect them, only to find that the convict is among the land baron's hired help.

programme.title: Stranded
programme.desc: David Robinson is being shipped off to a penal colony. His wife and kids are allowed to accompany him. A storm strikes the ship and the family (save for one son, Jacob) are trapped below deck. Jacob is raised by pirates, and the family gets out of the boat and on to land, salvaging as much as they can from the boat, including dogs, chickens, and muskets. They learn to survive and build a shelter on land. Then, Jacob's pirates kidnap Emily, the daughter of a sea-captain. She escapes onto the island and becomes a love interest with Fritz and Ernst. Jacob is reunited with his family during a battle with the pirates over Emily, and she is returned to her father. In the end, the family goes their own ways, some staying on the island, some going home.

programme.title: Vimbldonas. Official Film
programme.desc: Wimbledon is more than just a tennis tournament — it's a summer tradition, a slice of British culture, and one of the most iconic sporting events in the world. Held every year in London, England, usually in late June to early July, it's where the best tennis players on the planet come to battle it out on the famous grass courts of the All England Club. It's actually the oldest tennis tournament in the world, dating back to 1877, and it's still the only Grand Slam played on grass — the fastest and most unpredictable surface. That's part of what makes it so exciting. Matches are intense, fast-paced, and full of surprises. Wimbledon is packed with unique traditions that make it stand out. Players are required to wear all white on court — no exceptions. The crowd enjoys strawberries and cream, and you won't see flashy ads around the court — it's all about the game. And of course, there's the Royal Box, where you might spot celebrities or even members of the British Royal Family watching the action. From rising stars to tennis legends, everyone dreams of lifting the famous Wimbledon trophy. There's something magical about seeing players walk onto Centre Court, hearing the roar of the crowd, and witnessing moments that go down in sports history. Whether you're a tennis fan or just love great sports drama, Wimbledon is a must-watch — classy, thrilling, and full of unforgettable moments.

programme.title: Wild Argentina: Extreme Earth
programme.desc: In Argentina's breathtaking, yet imposing wilderness, every day is a fight for survival. The terrain is rugged and parched. The air is thin. The weather can change in an instant. And then there are the predators. A female puma stalks a valley in search of guanaco, while a tarantula defends itself against a hungry armadillo. Foxes will scavenge what they can…until one of the world's largest vultures shows up. All the while, in the background, glaciers greedily hold on to the freshwater these animals so desperately need.

programme.title: Freaks & Creep
programme.desc: Typically South Africa is known for the Big Five: lions, leopards, buffalo, elephants and rhinos. But not for Lucy Cooke, advocate and avenger for the lesser-known and unloved animals of the world. Lucy's on a hunt for the more enigmatic Freaky Five: Cape vultures, sungazer girdled lizards, golden-brown baboon tarantulas, ground pangolins, and chacma baboons. The Freaky Five are all important to South Africans and their traditions. Mystical and mysterious, these five animals represent a side of South African culture that the tourists and conservation donors both often overlook. But Lucy Cooke is on a mission to change all of that!

programme.title: Freaks & Creep
programme.desc: Lucy Cooke is on a one-woman mission to show why the ugly, weird and overlooked animals of the world can be cute, cuddly and deserving of attention. Join her as she heads off to the rainforests of Borneo. Borneo is its own very unique crucible of weirdness - with countless strange creatures that can only be found there. Lucy's goal is get up close with the giant-nosed proboscis monkey to figure out why this creature looks so strange. Along the way, she finds many other "odd ones" - animals that have come up with all kinds of strange adaptations so they can survive in the forest of Borneo. Lucy finds dung beetles in action - eating dung; frogs that fly; a tarsier, with eyes that are bigger than its brain; and the wooly bat that makes its home is a carnivorous plant.

programme.desc: At the tender age of 14, Jack Randall left his home in the UK to work under the guidance of legendary wildlife expert Steve Irwin. This documentary series showcases the ruthless beauty of this icy season, revealing the animals who thrive in their freezing conditions and the animals who simply fight for survival. When the season finally passes spring is reborn, and it is a celebration for those who managed to survive unscathed.

programme.title: Dolphins Up Close with Bertie Gregory
programme.desc: National Geographic Wild. Bertie aims to film thousands of migrating predators as they unite for one of the ocean's most spectacular feeding events off the coast of Portugal.

programme.title: Frozen Islands
programme.desc: It may be inhabitable for humans, but the icy ocean and frozen islands of the sub-antarctic region are home to millions of marine animals that have adapted to this testing environment. In this two-part series from National Geographic, the constant struggle for a wide variety of species is revealed, as they battle the elements and other dangers in a bid for survival. From penguins to seals, and albatrosses to whales, we showcase how these unique species live, breed and feed in the biting waters, which are also prowled by some of the most dangerous, underwater predators on our planet.

programme.title: Wild Life
programme.desc: Join wildlife filmmaker Bertie Gregory on a magical journey, as he visits stunning locations across the world to capture the beauty of some of our planet's most remarkable species. Traversing unique landscapes and unrelenting environments, Bertie takes his camera lens to some of the most inhospitable locations on Earth, hoping to film iconic species in their natural habitats. In the latest installment of this National Geographic series, Bertie navigates his way to the island of South Georgia, situated between Antarctica and South America, to capture the icy region's fascinating inhabitants.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: Reality show follows Dutch-born veterinarian Jan Pol, his family and employees' everyday. Jan Pol and his wife Diane started their own practice in Weidman, Michigan, Pol Veterinary Services, back in in 1981. Dr Pol takes a good care of every family pet and head of livestock no matter what size or condition and is a true legend in the community. Dr Pol has seen it all, treating numerous patients every single day, his daily routine is more than 12 hours but nothing can stop him from being devoted to his patients.

programme.title: Europe's New Wild
programme.desc: This stunning six-part nature series tells the inspiring story of the rebirthing of the wild regions of the continent of Europe. A land formerly full of diverse wildlife and contrasting landscapes, Europe was in need of special rewilding teams to embark on a mission to return species to their natural habitat and this series focuses on six regions that have benefitted from the project. The Carpathian Mountains of Romania have seen the reintroduction of European bison while rural depopulation in Spain and Portugal offers up the opportunity to expand the wild nature of the Iberian Peninsula. The teams also look at how bears and humans can live peacefully, side by side and explores the myriad creatures that call the Danube Delta home. The unique culture and atmosphere of Lapland plays host to distinctive wildlife and the Sámi people and a natural balance is being restored to the Balkans.

programme.title: Winter of the Bear
programme.desc: National Geographic Wild. In the forests of northern Finland, survival is a race against the seasons. For a mother brown bear, life between winters is a relentless battle as a single mother.

programme.title: Race to Winter
programme.desc: National Geographic Wild. As the first light of spring touches snow-covered landscapes, the race begins. Across fjords, forests, mountains and tundra, animals emerge from hiding to take advantage of summer's fleeting generosity.

programme.title: Wild Winter

programme.title: Snow School
programme.desc: National Geographic Wild. When every day is a snow day, school is always in session! Snowy climates can make for harsh living, and adulting is hard no matter where you are, but these young are flourishing.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters
programme.desc: Large carnivores such as leopards, lions and hyenas are in constant competition for their next meal for their pack in Zambia's Luangwa Valley. Following the lives of the wise old leopard Kamuti who rained over the prime territory in the Luangwa Valley for 10 years, a six-week-old lion cub and a clan of spotted hyenas, this documentary series allows audiences to see these magnificent animals like never before. With up-close imagery of animals existing within Luangwa Valley and their life in the wild, feel a part of the pack with Africa's Hunters.

programme.title: Built to Survive
programme.desc: Wet and Wild Rainforests. In the heat of the rainforest, Phil reveals the survival adaptations of the elusive tree kangaroo, colorful cassowary and lethal scrub python.

programme.title: Built to Survive
programme.desc: In the endless heat of the sands near Munga Thirri, (The Simpson Desert), Phil encounters Australia's largest lizard - the perentie, our fastest flightless bird - the emu, and the world's largest marsupial - the red kangaroo.

programme.title: Dingusių miestų atradimas su A. Linu
Best & Bester
programme.desc: Best and Bester are a pair of hilariously individual twins who live in a weird and wonderful alternate reality where your neighbour could be a pair of disgruntled trousers or your best friend a floating cloud of bottom burp. But, unlike their friends and neighbours, Best and Bester have the unique ability to choose a new body every single day and, in doing so, experience life in a completely different way.

programme.title: The Casagrandes
programme.desc: Family-orientated cartoon for kids. Mr. Grouper then says it's time to go outside, the "Outside" song plays, and the Guppies make up a story about the topic. programme.desc: The penguins notice it's been quiet at night. Too quiet, something's amiss. The rest of the zoo animals have been sneaking out at night to spend time partying in the park! The plan to sneak out then return by morning to avoid getting caught by Alice is put in jeopardy when they run into the classic New York problem - a traffic jam in the tunnel. How in the world can a traffic jam get cleared out of the tunnel in time? // The penguins make a new friend in Dode the dodo bird, who they clone back into existence after a pesky bout of extinction. Having grown up with no natural enemies, Dode has no fear and it leads him to daredevilish behavior - the kind that can make you extinct over and over again. The penguins don't want to see this keep happening to their friend, they need to find a way to slow this crazy bird down!

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: Littlefoot: Marlene is dying to go see a concert in the park. But, every time she leaves the zoo she becomes a feral monster! Kowalski comes to the rescue with his invention the Persona-Disentangleizer, which separates her savage nature from her regular self. The savage Marlene escapes and rampages through the city. Can the Penguins stop her before she destroys the city? Smotherly Love: Ma, an empty-nested mother possum, takes up residence in the Penguins Lair after they destroy her home during a battle with Hans the Puffin. She smothers the penguins with love and nurturing, and gets her new boys to behave by playing possum whenever necessary. The battle-hardened unit devolves into a bunch of softies, opening the door for Hans to take advantage. It looks like he has the upper wing, unless someone can make a play to stop him!

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents: A New Wish

At first, she is wrapped up in the thrill of solving a mystery, but things get real when the landlord goes missing. Everyone is a suspect - kids at school, the strange new neighbors, and even Cosmo and Wanda! Things intensify when Hazel suspects her family is the next target. In a dramatic climax at dinner at her neighbors', Hazel unveils the truth. Is it foul play? Or is it just her imagination?

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents: A New Wish
programme.desc: Hazel's feelings are hurt when her friends decide to go to the school dance instead of her book club. She storms off, but then realizes she wants to go to the dance too. Hazel wishes for Kennueth, a half-fish, half-man character from her favorite manga, to come out of his story and take her to the dance. programme.title: Football: French Ligue 1
programme.desc: PSG, AS Monaco, Marseille, Olympique Lyonnais & Lille... just to name a few. Ligue 1 is currently full of well-organised football teams and incredible European talent, who are a complement to the sport. As the highest professional division in France, it has established itself as one of the top five leagues on the continent. Lyon are the most successful team in regards to consecutive titles, whereas PSG and AS Monaco have managed to propel themselves to the highest achievements in the league, with calculated foreign investment. With the latter coming from a principality, Ligue 1 is another example of a domestic league that provides cross-border competition. From southern wine-growing regions such as Bordeaux, to the historically renowned capital of Paris, we cover the whole of France.

With the latter coming from a principality, Ligue 1 is another example of a domestic league that provides cross-border competition. From southern wine-growing regions such as Bordeaux, to the historically renowned capital of Paris, we cover the whole of France.

Un viaggio tranquillo che si trasforma presto in una catastrofe quando un esplosione distrugge la navicella causando la morte di tutti gli altri membri dell'equipaggio. I due astronauti vengono proiettati nello spazio profondo, senza alcun contatto con la Terra, apparentemente senza possibilita' di salvarsi.

Edgar Hoover: leggendario capo dell'FBI per quasi 50 anni, dal 1924 al 1972, sotto ben otto presidenti degli Stati Uniti. Il ritratto pubblico e privato di un uomo, e della sua strenua lotta contro la criminalità e il mondo dei gangster. Un uomo, considerato il più potente d'America, che non si fermò davanti a nulla pur di proteggere il proprio Paese. Anche a costo di infrangere ogni regola, scritta e non.

programme.title: Michael Collins
programme.desc: Leone d’oro a Venezia 1996 per il regista Neil Jordan e Coppa Volpi a Liam Neeson, leader guerrigliero nell'Irlanda lacerata e insanguinata dalle lotte del movimento indipendentista. Uscito di prigione dove era stato rinchiuso in seguito agli scontri armati di Dublino del 1916, Collins continua la sua lotta contro il dominio britannico, riuscendo a fare proseliti grazie al suo carisma. Intanto insieme a un gruppo di militanti, organizza attacchi e azioni di sabotaggio contro il governo che non esiterà a usare anche mezzi poco leciti per intimidirlo.

programme.title: The Independent: Complotto per la Casa Bianca

programme.title: Questo o quello: Harry Potter: buoni
programme.desc: Francesco Castelnuovo e Gianni Canova ci parlano dei personaggi "buoni" della saga, che potete vedere su Sky Cinema Harry Potter da giovedi' 1 a venerdi' 9 maggio.

programme.title: Harry Potter e i doni della morte: Parte I
programme.desc: Prima parte dell'adattamento dell'ultimo romanzo di J.K. Rowling. Insieme a Hermione e Ron, Harry deve trovare e distruggere gli horcrux, oggetti contenenti l'anima del Signore Oscuro.

programme.title: Harry Potter e i doni della morte: Parte II
programme.desc: Gran finale della saga in un tripudio di effetti speciali. Alla ricerca degli ultimi horcrux, Harry torna a Hogwarts, ma Voldemort ha scoperto la sua missione...

programme.title: Animali fantastici e dove trovarli
programme.desc: Oscar ai costumi per lo spin-off della saga di Harry Potter, scritto da J.K. Rowling. Il magizoologo Newt Scamander (Eddie Redmayne) arriva a New York con un inconsueto bagaglio...

programme.title: Animali fantastici: i crimini di Grindelwald
programme.desc: Eddie Redmayne, Johnny Depp e Jude Law nel secondo spin-off della saga di "Harry Potter", scritto da J.K. Rowling. Albus Silente deve fermare il diabolico piano dell'evaso Grindelwald.

programme.title: Harry Potter e la pietra filosofale
programme.desc: Primo capitolo della saga con Daniel Radcliffe. Dotato di poteri speciali, il piccolo Harry Potter inizia la sua avventura alla scuola di magia di Hogwarts e affronta il malvagio Voldemort.

programme.title: David Holmes - Il ragazzo che è sopravvissuto
programme.desc: La storia di David Holmes, stuntman nei film di Harry Potter, paralizzato dopo un incidente sul set. Una riflessione sulla resistenza e la forza dei legami.

programme.title: Questo o quello - Speciale
programme.desc: Quattro pellicole natalizie, che hanno riscosso il successo di pubblico, disponibili su Sky Cinema.

programme.title: Bumblebee
programme.desc: Hailee Steinfeld e John Cena nello spin off della saga di "Transformers", prodotto da Steven Spielberg. In missione sulla Terra, un Autobot rimane ferito e si trasforma in un Maggiolino.

programme.title: I predatori dell'arca perduta
programme.desc: Primo capitolo della saga con Harrison Ford, ideata da George Lucas e diretta da Steven Spielberg. Anni 30: l'archeologo Indiana Jones parte alla ricerca dell'Arca dell'Alleanza.

programme.title: Indiana Jones e il tempio maledetto
programme.desc: Oscar agli effetti speciali per la seconda avventura con Harrison Ford, diretta da Steven Spielberg. In India, l'archeologo scopre l’esistenza di un tempio dove si compiono sacrifici umani.

programme.title: La leggenda degli uomini straordinari
programme.desc: L'avventuriero Allan Quatermain (Sean Connery) guida una squadra di eroi della letteratura popolare per fermare il folle piano di Phantom che vuole distruggere il mondo.

programme.title: Lucy
programme.desc: Scarlett Johansson e Morgan Freeman nel fanta-action di Luc Besson. Un criminale inietta una misteriosa sostanza chimica nel corpo di una studentessa che sviluppa poteri sbalorditivi.

programme.title: I mercenari 2
programme.desc: Sylvester Stallone e le migliori star dell'action in un trascinante sequel. La squadra di mercenari al soldo della Cia deve vendicare l'omicidio di un collega, ucciso da un terrorista.

programme.title: Un uomo sopra la legge
programme.desc: Action con Liam Neeson al confine tra Messico e Stati Uniti. Un allevatore, veterano del Vietnam, difende un bambino immigrato dagli implacabili assassini di un cartello del narcotraffico.

programme.title: Indiana Jones e l'ultima crociata
programme.desc: Steven Spielberg dirige Harrison Ford e Sean Connery nel terzo capitolo, premiato con un Oscar. Jones padre e figlio incontrano i nazisti sulla strada per la conquista del Santo Graal.

programme.title: Indiana Jones e il regno del teschio di cristallo
programme.desc: Il grande ritorno di Harrison Ford nel quarto capitolo con Cate Blanchett e Shia LaBeouf. Pedinato dai sovietici Indy deve ritrovare una reliquia dai poteri soprannaturali.

programme.title: I mercenari 3
programme.desc: Il cast stellare ritorna nel terzo capitolo dell'adrenalinica saga action. La ricomparsa di uno storico nemico costringe Barney a trovare nuove forze per l'ultima missione.

programme.title: Robin Hood
programme.desc: Ridley Scott dirige Russell Crowe e Cate Blanchett. Tornato in patria dopo aver combattuto per l'Inghilterra, un arciere si ribella all'usurpatore del trono di re Riccardo I.

programme.title: Superman
programme.desc: Un neonato proveniente da una galassia remota viene inviato a vivere sulla Terra. Con il passare degli anni, Clark Kent scopre di possedere dei super poteri e inizia a utilizzarli per lottare contro le forze del male.

programme.title: The Legend of Tarzan
programme.desc: L'intramontabile storia del Re della giungla con Alexander Skarsgard, Margot Robbie e Samuel L. Jackson. Dopo tanti anni a Londra, Tarzan torna in Congo ma viene coinvolto in un complotto.

programme.title: La rapina perfetta
programme.desc: Jason Statham nell'action che ricostruisce la storica rapina del 1972 ai danni della Baker Street Bank di Londra le cui dinamiche coinvolsero la mafia, il Governo e la Monarchia.

programme.title: Interceptor, il guerriero della strada
programme.desc: Secondo capitolo di Mad Max con Mel Gibson diretto da George Miller. Divisi in 2 clan rivali, i pochi umani superstiti ingaggiano una violenta battaglia per il carburante rimasto.

programme.title: Shark - Il primo squalo
programme.desc: Jason Statham in un action ambientato negli abissi. Un esperto in missioni impossibili deve salvare un team di esploratori da un megalodonte, una specie estinta milioni di anni fa.

programme.title: Superman II
programme.desc: Sulla Torre Eiffel, Superman salva degli ostaggi minacciati da terroristi. Tra gli altri c'è anche la giornalista Lois Lane, di cui è collega sotto la falsa identità di Clark Kent.

programme.title: Mr. Morfina
programme.desc: Action-comedy con Jack Quaid e Ray Nicholson. Nate e' un timido banchiere affetto da una rara malattia che lo rende insensibile al dolore fisico. Ma questa sindrome, pericolosa e maledetta, diventa la sua arma per liberare la donna che ama da una banda di criminali.

programme.title: King Arthur: Il potere della spada
programme.desc: Guy Ritchie rilegge il mito di Re Artù, con Charlie Hunnam e Jude Law. Cresciuto nei sobborghi di Londra, Arthur estrae la spada dalla roccia e sfida Vortigern per sedere sul trono.

programme.title: Transformers
programme.desc: Shia LaBeouf e Megan Fox nel primo capitolo della saga sci-fi prodotta da Steven Spielberg. Due razze aliene, gli Autobots e i Decepticons, scelgono la Terra come campo di battaglia.

programme.title: La rapina perfetta
programme.desc: Jason Statham nell'action che ricostruisce la storica rapina del 1972 ai danni della Baker Street Bank di Londra le cui dinamiche coinvolsero la mafia, il Governo e la Monarchia.

programme.title: Rampage - Furia animale
programme.desc: Bestie feroci all'attacco in un action catastrofico con Dwayne Johnson. Un esperimento genetico trasforma George, un mansueto gorilla albino, in una creatura sanguinaria. Le sue dimensioni, inoltre, aumentano a dismisura. Un esperto di scimmie, Davis Okoye, che aveva stretto un affettuoso rapporto con il primate, vuole vederci chiaro. Indagando sull'accaduto scopre che altri animali sono stati sottoposti allo stesso trattamento. Un lupo e un coccodrillo stanno andando incontro alla medesima alterazione di George: serve al più presto un antidoto per fermare la loro rabbia distruttrice.

programme.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
programme.desc: Tom Holland interpreta l'Uomo Ragno nel film con Michael Keaton e Robert Downey Jr. - Reduce dall'esperienza con gli Avengers, Spider-Man difende l'umanità dagli artigli dell'Avvoltoio.

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes
programme.desc: Robert Downey Jr. e Jude Law in una rilettura nel segno del fantastico del celebre detective. Holmes e il fidato Watson devono indagare su una serie di delitti legati alla magia nera.

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes - Gioco di ombre
programme.desc: Robert Downey Jr., Jude Law e Noomi Rapace nel sequel diretto da Guy Ritchie. Sherlock Holmes e l'inseparabile Watson indagano sugli attentati che stanno insanguinando l'Europa.

programme.title: Sicario
programme.desc: Acclamato action di Denis Villeneuve con Benicio Del Toro, Emily Blunt e Josh Brolin. Arruolata nella lotta al narcotraffico messicano, un'agente FBI scivola in una spirale infernale.

programme.title: Braven - Il coraggioso
programme.desc: Action tra i boschi innevati con Jason Momoa. Un taglialegna deve difendere la propria famiglia da una banda di trafficanti che ha nascosto un carico di droga nella sua baita.

programme.title: The Kill Team
programme.desc: Nat Wolff e Alexander Skarsgard in un film tratto da una storia vera. Afghanistan: in un plotone incaricato di stanare terroristi, un soldato entra in conflitto con il suo superiore.

programme.title: Catwoman
programme.desc: Halle Berry interpreta la sensuale eroina della DC Comics. Una pubblicitaria, uccisa per aver scoperto un cosmetico letale, risorge grazie a un gatto magico e acquisisce superpoteri felini.

programme.desc: Tom Holland, Jake Gyllenhaal e Samuel L. Jackson nel cinecomic da oltre un miliardo di dollari d'incasso. L'Uomo Ragno affronta gli Elementali al fianco dell'eroe di una terra parallela.

programme.title: Uncharted
programme.desc: Blockbuster d'avventura dal noto videogame, con Tom Holland, Mark Wahlberg e Antonio Banderas. In cerca del tesoro di Magellano, Nathan Drake e Sully affrontano il perfido Santiago Moncada.

programme.title: 12 Soldiers
programme.desc: Chris Hemsworth e Michael Shannon in un war-movie tratto da una storia vera. Dopo l'11 settembre, una squadra speciale Usa sbarca in Afghanistan per organizzare la guerra contro Al Qaeda.

programme.desc: Stefano Sollima dirige Benicio Del Toro e Josh Brolin nel sequel di "Sicario". Ingaggiato dall'FBI, un uomo misterioso intensifica la guerra al narcotraffico fra Messico e Stati Uniti.

programme.desc: Julia Roberts e Hugh Grant nell'amabile commedia romantica di Roger Michell scritta da Richard Curtis. Un timido librario londinese incontra una diva di Hollywood... e sboccia l'amore.

programme.title: Emma
programme.desc: Dal romanzo di Jane Austen, una storia di intese amorose con Gwyneth Paltrow. 1800: una giovane aristocratica inglese aiuta una ragazza timida a trovare l'uomo giusto. Oscar alle musiche.

programme.title: Il grande Gatsby
programme.desc: Baz Luhrmann (il regista di "Mouline Rouge!") dirige Leonardo DiCaprio, Carey Mulligan e Tobey Maguire nello sfarzoso adattamento, vincitore di due Oscar, del celebre romanzo di Francis S. Fitzgerald, pilastro della letteratura statunitense. America, anni '20: un aspirante scrittore, Nick Carraway, entra nel mondo di Jay Gatsby, un misterioso milionario ossessionato dall'amore impossibile per Daisy: la donna da lui amata e che vorrebbe riconquistare. Nick verra' a contatto con l'atmosfera festosa dell'eta' del jazz che si consuma in illusioni, malinconie e sogni effimeri.

programme.title: Ex
programme.desc: Fausto Brizzi dirige una commedia corale con Claudio Bisio, Nancy Brilli e Alessandro Gassmann. La ricomparsa degli ex mette in crisi il rapporto di sei coppie.

programme.title: Che cosa aspettarsi quando si aspetta
programme.desc: Cameron Diaz, Jennifer Lopez e Anna Kendrick in una romantica commedia corale. Cinque coppie in dolce attesa si preparano alle gioie e alle preoccupazioni del loro futuro da genitori.

programme.title: Shall We Dance?
programme.desc: Richard Gere e Jennifer Lopez per una commedia romantica a passo di danza. Lui e' un avvocato di successo con una bella famiglia ma si sente infelice. Lei e' l'insegnante di ballo che potrebbe aiutarlo a colmare il suo vuoto interiore.

programme.title: Chocolat
programme.desc: Juliette Binoche e Johnny Depp in una 'dolce' commedia che stimola i sensi. In un paesino della Francia, una donna decide di aprire una cioccolateria che riscuote un grandissimo successo.

programme.title: Notting Hill
programme.desc: Julia Roberts e Hugh Grant nell'amabile commedia romantica di Roger Michell scritta da Richard Curtis. Un timido librario londinese incontra una diva di Hollywood... e sboccia l'amore.

programme.title: Corro da te

programme.desc: Sette Oscar all’intenso dramma di Sydney Pollack con Meryl Streep e Robert Redford, tratto dall’autobiografia di Karen Blixen. La scrittrice ripercorre gli anni passati in Kenya.

programme.title: La casa sul lago del tempo
programme.desc: Sandra Bullock e Keanu Reeves in una love story che trascende lo spazio e il tempo. Arrivato nella sua nuova casa sul lago, Alex trova una lettera della precedente inquilina, Kate, con cui inizia un rapporto epistolare. I due continuano a scriversi e finiscono per innamorarsi, ma scoprono di non potersi incontrare perche' vivono in anni diversi: lui nel 2004, lei nel 2006. Ispirato a "Il mare", film coreano inedito in Italia diretto da Hyun-Seung Lee, con Sandra Bullock e Keanu Reeves che tornano a lavorare insieme 12 anni dopo "Speed".

programme.desc: Dal regista di "Ghostbusters" una commedia piccante con due sex symbol di Hollywood, Natalie Portman e Ashton Kutcher. Adam scopre che suo padre (Kevin Kline) ha sedotto la sua fidanzata. Davanti a un simile trauma, il ragazzo si ubriaca e finisce a casa di Emma. I due, amici di lunga data, finiscono a letto insieme e decidono di instaurare una relazione puramente fisica, senza alcun coinvolgimento: ci si diverte ma i sentimenti devono esser tenuti ben lontani. Un reciproco accordo che sembra anche funzionare, ma sara' sempre piu' difficile tenere a bada il cuore...

programme.desc: Julia Roberts e Richard Gere di nuovo insieme nella commedia romantica dal regista di "Pretty Woman". Ike Graham e' un cronista di New York in cerca di un'idea per il prossimo pezzo da consegnare al suo capo, la sua ex moglie. Per caso, in un bar, sente parlare di una donna, Maggie Carpenter, che piu' di una volta ha abbandonato sull'altare i suoi fidanzati. Ike le dedica il suo prossimo articolo, finendo per scatenare l'ira della donna che ne ottiene il licenziamento. Ma Ike non si da' per vinto e decide di fare un viaggio fino nel Maryland per scoprire la verita'.

programme.title: Collateral Beauty
programme.desc: Will Smith è la star di un commovente dramma sul dolore e la perdita. Segnato dalla morte della figlia, Howard, un pubblicitario di New York, si chiude in se stesso perdendo ogni interesse per cio' che lo circonda. L'unica sua reazione concreta consiste nella scrittura di lettere indirizzate alla Morte, al Tempo e all'Amore. Ai suoi amici non resta che assecondarlo mentre escogitano un piano per aiutarlo a riprendere in mano la propria vita. Dal regista de "Il diavolo veste Prada". Cast da tappeto rosso: Edward Norton, Keira Knightley, Naomie Harris e i premi Oscar Helen Mirren e Kate Winslet.

programme.title: Gli ultimi saranno ultimi
programme.desc: Dramma sociale di Massimiliano Bruno con Paola Cortellesi e Alessandro Gassmann. La vita di una donna, licenziata perche' incinta, si intreccia con quella di un poliziotto tormentato.

programme.title: Hey Joe
programme.desc: Claudio Giovannesi dirige James Franco in una pellicola sulle conseguenze dei conflitti. Venticinque anni dopo, il veterano Dean torna a Napoli alla ricerca del figlio.

programme.title: Dall'alto di una fredda torre
programme.desc: Edoardo Pesce e Vanessa Scalera in una toccante pellicola. La normalita' di una famiglia viene spezzata quando si scopre che entrambi i genitori sono malati e solo uno puo' essere salvato.

programme.title: Il seme del fico sacro
programme.desc: Premio a Cannes e una candidatura agli Oscar per la coraggiosa opera di Mohammad Rasoulof. Nell'Iran delle proteste giovanili, l'unione di una famiglia viene messa a dura prova.

programme.title: Mr Cobbler e la bottega magica
programme.desc: Adam Sandler vive mille avventure in una commedia fantastica dal regista premio Oscar per "Il caso Spotlight". Max Simkin e' un solitario calzolaio newyorkese che conduce una vita grigia e monotona. Almeno fino a quando, nella sua bottega, non scopre una vecchia risuolatrice: un vero e proprio cimelio, che gli permette di trasformarsi in ognuno dei suoi clienti semplicemente indossando le loro scarpe. Max ne approfittera' per dare un lustro piu' elettrizzante e avventuroso alla sua esistenza, assumendo varie identita' e andando incontro a momenti divertenti e imprevisti imbarazzanti.

programme.desc: Prosegue la collaborazione fra Dovizioso e Honda e, nel 2007, Andrea approda in MotoGP. Il “Grizzly” è il suo fisioterapista e amico: un personaggio chiave nella carriera del Dovi.

programme.title: Ep9 - Desmodovi
programme.desc: Andrea Dovizioso, freddo e razionale, è agli antipodi del pilota storicamente amato dal pubblico dei ducatisti. Ma pur rimanendo fedele a sé stesso riesce a farsi amare e ne diventa un idolo.

programme.title: Tanging Yaman
programme.desc: Three siblings Danny, Art and Grace are now well settled with their respective families, in widely contrasting lifestyles. The one common thing that binds them loosely together is the love that their mother Dolores \"Loleng\" Rosales holds for all of them and her grandchildren, albeit expressed in varying ways and degrees, but always equally nurturing and self-giving. Much as they are held together by her, they are in turn separated by physical distance and the sad legacy left behind by their deceased, erstwhile strong-willed, patriarchal father.

programme.title: Must Be Love
programme.desc: A tomboyish young girl is distraught when her male best friend starts courting another girl. She must consider changing herself in order to win him over.

programme.title: Finally Found Someone
programme.desc: Aprilyn who is left by his groom on the day of their wedding becomes viral online. Devastated, she meets Raffy who works at a PR agency hired by the father of the groom who will help her move on.

programme.title: Ang Tanging Ina N'yong Lahat
programme.desc: An unstoppable mother of twelve children gets a job at the presidential palace and ends up in the public eye after unwittingly saving the president's life. She gets thrust onto the national stage, and soon finds herself running for president, charming the country with her own unique brand of mother widom.

programme.title: Paglisan
programme.desc: Crisanto and Dolores' marriage is going through a rough patch. Going through marital crisis, a couple's marriage is tested when Crisanto is diagnosed with early onset Alzheimers disease as Dolores sinks deeper into depression. Paglisan tells the story of how a married couple attempt to survive together through fading memories and fleeting identities.

programme.title: CSI S5 E04 - Crow's Feet
programme.desc: Some provocative episodes from Season 5 of CSI involve Russian mail order brides (\"Nesting Dolls\"), infantism (\"King Baby\"), and the Mexican lifestyle of narcocorrido (\"Snakes\"). From the creative storytelling (\"4x4\") to the macabre (\"Who Shot Sherlock?\"), there’s something in Season 5 for everyone. The CSI team investigates many crimes that hit close to home as well. Grissom comes under fire from Ecklie (\"Mea Culpa\"), Brass tracks down his estranged daughter (\"Hollywood Brass\"), and during the course of the season Greg Sanders completes his transition from the lab to the field. Last, but not least, Season 5 wraps with an amazing two-part episode (\"Grave Danger\"), written and directed by Quentin Tarantino, where Nick comes face to face with death while the team exhausts all its resources to same him.

programme.title: Bekikang: Ang Nanay Kong Beki
programme.desc: A gay man unexpectedly becomes the guardian of a child belonging to a man he has fallen in love with.

programme.title: Diary Ng Panget
programme.desc: A poor, self-described ugly girl takes a job as a personal maid for a rich, handsome young man. The two don't get along, but as they get tangled in their classmates' games of affection, their relationship becomes more complicated.

programme.title: Mahal Kita, Beksman
programme.desc: Dali's life, a make-up artist and fashion designer, is happy and gay. But when he falls in love... Surprise! He's straight!

programme.title: Instant Daddy
programme.desc: upcoming Philippine remake movie of 2013 Mexican hit movie Instructions Not Included.

programme.title: Wish You Were The One
programme.desc: A woman desperately trying to crash a wedding, in hopes of winning back her chef ex, finds luck when a man going to the same wedding is looking for someone to pretend as his fiancée. But when the two pretend to be engaged, even using memories from their past relationships as their history, they find that they may feel something real for each other.

programme.title: Ikaw Pa Rin Ang Pipiliin Ko
programme.desc: Music gives her life. Music is his life. This is a story that will make our hearts skip a beat this season of love. Ikaw Pa Rin ang Pipiliin Ko, a May-December romance, promises the fresh tandem of Aga and Julia, who portray a musical conductor and chorister, respectively.

programme.title: Rigodon
programme.desc: A heartbroken young woman begins a sexual relationship with a struggling artista, not knowing that her new beau is already married. As the truth comes out, obsession and jealousy bring pain into all their lives.

programme.title: Our Season
programme.desc: Bok-ja is granted a special vacation after her death, which allows her to go see her daughter, Jin-joo, a university professor living abroad. Unlike her expectation, Bok-ja finds Jin-joo living in her old house running a local diner and becomes frustrated with questions that she is unable to ask. After spending time alongside Jin-joo, Bok-ja realizes that her daughter is struggling with the unresolved feelings about her, and tries to find a way to show her sincere feelings that she had never shared before.

programme.title: Confidential Assignment 2: International
programme.desc: Follows Rim Chul Ryung heading back to South Korea in pursuit of a brutal and secret criminal organization. He teams up again with Kang Jin Tae, who volunteers to work with the North Korean in order to get back on the investigation team after a mistake landed him in the cyber crime department.

programme.title: Justice League (2017)
programme.desc: Fueled by his restored faith in humanity and inspired by Superman's selfless act, Bruce Wayne enlists the help of his newfound ally, Diana Prince, to face an even greater enemy. Together, Batman and Wonder Woman work quickly to find and recruit a team of metahumans to stand against this newly awakened threat. But despite the formation of this unprecedented league of heroes – Batman, Wonder Woman, Aquaman, Cyborg and The Flash – it may already be too late to save the planet from an assault of catastrophic proportions.

programme.title: Shazam!
programme.desc: We all have a superhero inside us, it just takes a bit of magic to bring it out. In Billy Batson’s (Asher Angel) case, by shouting out one word—SHAZAM!—this streetwise 14-year-old foster kid can turn into the adult Super Hero Shazam (Zachary Levi), courtesy of an ancient wizard (Djimon Hounsou). Still a kid at heart—inside a ripped, godlike body—Shazam revels in this adult version of himself by doing what any teen would do with superpowers: have fun with them! Can he fly? Does he have X-ray vision? Can he shoot lightning out of his hands? Can he skip his social studies test? Shazam sets out to test the limits of his abilities with the joyful recklessness of a child. But he’ll need to master these powers quickly in order to fight the deadly forces of evil controlled by Dr. Thaddeus Sivana (Mark Strong).

programme.desc: A bin from \"down under\" holds a dark and mysterious surprise. Jessie vows to keep everyone from making any profit. Papa Bear pushes Brandon to the brink, and T Money gets a taste of the geriatric life.

programme.desc: On the hottest day of the year, will the sun cause the bidders to make crazy decisions? In the sweltering heat, the bidders must fight for the ultimate blind buy - a unit completely hidden behind a sheet of plastic!

programme.desc: Brandon arrives solo to the auction, but still flexes his muscle. The men gamble on an abandoned recording studio. And a trailer with Civil War items incites the men to wage a bidding war.

programme.title: Storage Hunters S6 20

programme.title: Storage Hunters S6 21
programme.desc: The bidders take a trip to Canyon Country to bid on huge trailers. A mysterious concrete block and a trailer full of hay mean big opportunities and lead to unusual alliances within the group.

programme.title: Storage Hunters S6 22
programme.desc: Lori and Brandon get in a fight over a bin and make a wager to see who can do better. Lori eyes a bin with a tanning bed, while a bin with fake walls intrigues Brandon. Meanwhile, Papa Bear and Jesse vie for a bin full of antique furniture.

programme.title: Storage Hunters S6 23

programme.title: Er S1 16
programme.desc: A woman abandons her recently adopted, AIDS-stricken daughter at the emergency room; a cop brings in a dog he hit with his car.

programme.title: Blood Diamond
programme.desc: Academy Award nominees Leonardo DiCaprio and Djimon Hounsou join Academy Award winner Jennifer Connelly in this action drama from Ed Zwick, the filmmaker behind The Last Samurai. DiCaprio stars as Danny Archer, a mercenary smuggler searching for a priceless diamond amid the chaos of Sierra Leone's civil war; Hounsou (Gladiator), as a desperate father searching for his lost son; and Connelly (A Beautiful Mind), as a reporter searching for the truth behind the trade in 'conflict diamonds.' Forced to confront the brutal human cost of the diamond trade, Archer changes his search for financial reward to a quest for redemption.

programme.title: Inception
programme.desc: Your mind is the scene of the crime. Box-office superstar Leonardo DiCaprio stars in this contemporary science fiction action film set \"within the architecture of the mind.\" Written, directed and produced by Oscar and Golden Globe nominee Christopher Nolan (The Dark Knight, Batman Begins, The Prestige), this eagerly awaited follow-up to 2008's billion-dollar blockbuster is yet another visionary tale from a startingly original filmmaker who continually raises the bar with every film he makes. Shooting in London, Paris, Tangiers, Calgary and Los Angeles, Nolan's mind-bending film also stars Academy Award winners Michael Caine and Marion Cotillard, in addition to Juno's Ellen Page, Batman Begins' Cillian Murphy and Oscar nominees Ken Watanabe (The Last Samurai) and Tom Berenger (Platoon).

programme.title: Get Smart
programme.desc: Comic superstar Steve Carell takes on the role of Agent Maxwell Smart and Anne Hathaway steps into the shoes of sexy Agent 99 as the two superspies out to save the world from the nefarious forces of KAOS in this romp based on the classic television show created by Mel Brooks and Buck Henry.

programme.title: Pacific Rim
programme.desc: Acclaimed filmmaker Guillermo del Toro (Pan's Labyrinth) brings out the big guns in this sci-fi action epic about a ragtag band of humans that band together in the year 2025 to fight legions of monstrous creatures rising from the sea. Using massive piloted robots to combat the alien threat, earth's survivors (including Charlie Hunnam, Charlie Day \u0026 Rinko Kikuchi) take the fight to the invading alien force lurking in the depths of the Pacific Ocean. Nearly defenseless in the face of the relentless enemy, the forces of mankind have no choice but to turn to two unlikely heroes -- a washed up former pilot and an untested trainee -- who now stand as earth's final hope against the mounting apocalypse.

programme.title: The Legend Of Tarzan (2016)
programme.desc: A new live-action adventure from director David Yates (Harry Potter films) brings Edgar Rice Burroughs' legendary character back to the big screen. It's been years since the man once known as Tarzan (Alexander Skarsgard --True Blood) left the jungles of Africa behind for a gentrified life as John Clayton III, Lord Greystoke, with his beloved wife, Jane (Margot Robbie --The Wolf of Wall Street) at his side. Now, he has been invited back to the Congo to serve as a trade emissary of Parliament, unaware that he is a pawn in a deadly convergence of greed and revenge, masterminded by the Belgian, Captain Leon Rom (Oscar® winner Christoph Waltz). But those behind the murderous plot have no idea what they are about to unleash.

programme.title: King Arthur: Legend Of The Sword
programme.desc: Acclaimed filmmaker Guy Ritchie brings his dynamic style to the epic fantasy action adventure \"King Arthur: Legend of the Sword.\" Starring Charlie Hunnam in the title role, the film is an iconoclastic take on the classic Excalibur myth, tracing Arthur's journey from the streets to the throne. When the child Arthur's father is murdered, Vortigern (Jude Law), Arthur's uncle, seizes the crown. Robbed of his birthright and with no idea who he truly is, Arthur comes up the hard way in the back alleys of the city. But once he pulls the sword from the stone, his life is turned upside down and he is forced to acknowledge his true legacy...whether he likes it or not.

programme.title: Wanted
programme.desc: Seorang pemalas direkrut oleh organisasi pembunuh bayaran rahasia. Saat berlatih di bawah bimbingan para pembunuh elit di sana, ia berhasil mengungkap kekuatan tersembunyi dan rahasia kelam yang mereka simpan.

programme.title: Universal Soldier
programme.desc: Dua tentara saingan yang terbunuh di Vietnam dihidupkan kembali dalam sebuah eksperimen militer nan sangat rahasia demi menciptakan para prajurit berkekuatan super.

programme.title: The Huntsman: Winter's War
programme.desc: Film ini menceritakan kisah yang terjadi sebelum kisah Snow White And The Huntsman. Selama perang antara dua ratu, sang pemburu harus mengalahkan sang ratu jahat sebelum ia berkuasa untuk selamanya.

programme.title: Fast & Furious 7
programme.desc: Deckard Shaw berusaha membalaskan dendamnya kepada Dominic Toretto dan keluarganya untuk saudaranya yang sedang terbaring koma.

programme.title: Around The World In 80 Days
programme.desc: Pada tahun 1872, seorang penemu asal Inggris, pencuri asal Tiongkok, dan seniman asal Prancis berkeliling dunia dalam waktu 80 hari via jalur darat, udara, dan laut menggunakan sepatu roda untuk mencapai tujuan mereka.

programme.title: Total Recall (1990)
programme.desc: Pada tahun 2084, pekerja konstruksi Douglas Quaid pergi mengunjungi Rekall untuk liburan virtual ke Mars. Namun, prosedur itu malah membuka sejumlah ingatan tersembunyi dan menjerumuskannya ke dalam pemberontakan maut.

programme.title: Get Out
programme.desc: Kegelisahan seorang pemuda keturunan Afrika-Amerika terhadap sambutan orangtua kekasihnya yang berkulit putih mencapai puncaknya saat ia mengunjungi mereka di akhir pekan.

programme.title: The Woman King
programme.desc: Film aksi yang diangkat dari kisah nyata ini menceritakan tentang Viola Davis yang memimpin pasukan elit wanita yang bertekad membela negara mereka.

programme.title: Robin Hood
programme.desc: Di Inggris pada abad ke-12, Robin dan kelompok perampoknya menghadapi korupsi di desa setempat dan memimpin pemberontakan melawan penguasa yang nantinya akan mengubah keseimbangan kekuasaan di dunia.

programme.title: Captain Phillips
programme.desc: Kapal Maersk Alabama yang tengah menuju Kenya dibajak oleh sekelompok perompak Somalia yang dipimpin oleh Abduwali Muse. Namun tak lama kemudian, Muse dan kapten kapal tersebut terjebak dalam situasi nan ekstrem.

programme.title: Hard Target
programme.desc: Jean-Claude Van Damme harus memperdaya sebuah grup yang membunuh manusia demi kepuasan pribadi.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Catching Fire
programme.desc: Katniss Everdeen dan Peeta Mellark menjadi incaran Capitol setelah kemenangan mereka di Hunger Games ke-74 memicu aksi pemberontakan di semua distrik di Panem.

programme.title: Kindergarten Cop
programme.desc: Seorang polisi tangguh, John Kimble, menghadapi tantangan terberatnya saat ia harus menyamar sebagai seorang guru Taman Kanak-kanak demi menangkap seorang bandar narkoba.

programme.title: The World's End
programme.desc: Lima teman masa kecil bersatu kembali dua puluh tahun setelah mereka mencoba mabuk-mabukan di beberapa bar sekaligus dalam semalam dan berusaha untuk mendatangi sebuah bar legendaris: The World's End.

programme.title: Terminator 2: Judgement Day
programme.desc: Sesosok siborg nan identik dengan siborg yang gagal membunuh Sarah Connor kini harus melindungi putranya yang berusia sepuluh tahun, John, dari siborg lain yang lebih canggih dan kuat.

programme.title: Jurassic World
programme.desc: Seorang mantan ahli hewan militer turun tangan saat suatu taman hiburan yang berisi sekawanan dinosaurus hasil rekayasa genetika berubah mengerikan bagi para wisatawan karena salah satu dinosaurus lepas dari kandang.

programme.title: The Woman King
programme.desc: Film aksi yang diangkat dari kisah nyata ini menceritakan tentang Viola Davis yang memimpin pasukan elit wanita yang bertekad membela negara mereka.

programme.title: Fast & Furious 7
programme.desc: Deckard Shaw berusaha membalaskan dendamnya kepada Dominic Toretto dan keluarganya untuk saudaranya yang sedang terbaring koma.

programme.title: Get Out

programme.title: The Mummy
programme.desc: Tom Cruise berperan sebagai seorang tentara AS yang harus menghentikan terjadinya pembinasaan umat manusia akibat kebangkitan seorang putri dari zaman kuno yang telah memendam kedengkian selama ribuan tahun.

programme.title: Moby Dick, Pt 1
programme.desc: Satu-satunya orang yang selamat dari sebuah kapal penangkap ikan paus yang hilang menceritakan kisah tentang obsesi kapten kapalnya untuk berburu seekor paus putih, Moby Dick.

programme.title: Moby Dick, Pt 2
programme.desc: Satu-satunya orang yang selamat dari sebuah kapal penangkap ikan paus yang hilang menceritakan kisah tentang obsesi kapten kapalnya untuk berburu seekor paus putih, Moby Dick.

programme.title: The Librarian: King Solomon
programme.desc: Film ini bercerita tentang seorang pustakawan yang beralih profesi menjadi petualang bernama Flynn Carsen dalam upayanya untuk menemukan tambang Raja Solomon.

programme.title: Around The World In 80 Days

programme.title: U-571
programme.desc: Terinspirasi oleh peristiwa nyata pada masa Perang Dunia II, film ini bercerita tentang awak kapal selam Amerika yang ditugaskan menangkap kapal selam Jerman yang membawa mesin sandi Enigma.

programme.title: Back To The Future 3
programme.desc: Marty McFly kembali ke tahun 1885 untuk mencegah agar rekannya, Doktor Emmet Brown, tidak tewas di tangan Buford 'Mad Dog' Tannen!

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Hobbs & Shaw
programme.desc: Dalam film nan penuh kejutan ini, Hobbs dan Shaw bekerja sama untuk menghentikan seorang penjahat super yang memiliki senjata biologis nan mematikan.

programme.title: Tai Chi Master
programme.desc: Dua sahabat mengambil jalan berbeda saat terseret dalam pemberontakan melawan pemerintah. Salah satunya tumbuh menjadi komandan militer, sementara yang lain memilih mempelajari teknik Tai Chi yang menenangkan.

programme.title: The Man With The Iron Fists
programme.desc: Saat berburu harta karun emas, sekelompok prajurit, pembunuh, dan seorang pembelot asal Inggris pergi ke sebuah desa di Tiongkok dan bertemu seorang pandai besi baik hati yang tengah berjuang mempertahankan desanya.

programme.title: Total Recall (1990)
programme.desc: Pada tahun 2084, pekerja konstruksi Douglas Quaid pergi mengunjungi Rekall untuk liburan virtual ke Mars. Namun, prosedur itu malah membuka sejumlah ingatan tersembunyi dan menjerumuskannya ke dalam pemberontakan maut.

programme.title: Tears Of The Sun
programme.desc: Seorang anggota Navy SEAL ditugaskan untuk menyelamatkan seorang dokter Amerika yang terdampar di perang yang melanda Nigeria, namun ia menghadapi banyak masalah yang tak terduga.

programme.title: Around The World In 80 Days
programme.desc: Pada tahun 1872, seorang penemu asal Inggris, pencuri asal Tiongkok, dan seniman asal Prancis berkeliling dunia dalam waktu 80 hari via jalur darat, udara, dan laut menggunakan sepatu roda untuk mencapai tujuan mereka.

programme.title: The Huntsman: Winter's War

programme.title: Bad Boys

programme.title: Furiosa: A Mad Max Saga
programme.desc: Stuck in the middle of the conflict between Dementus and Immortan Joe, Furiosa fights to escape from their clutches and return to her safe haven, the Green Place.

programme.title: Ghost Rider: Spirit of Vengeance
programme.desc: A French monk seeks out the Ghost Rider, a superpowered antihero, for help in protecting a young boy who is being pursued by the Devil and his minions.

programme.title: Spider-Man
programme.desc: Peter Parker's life changes when he is bitten by a genetically altered spider and gains superpowers. He uses his powers to help people and finds himself facing the Green Goblin, an evil maniac.

programme.title: Transformers: Revenge of the Fallen
programme.desc: Sam and Mikaela once again join forces with Optimus Prime and the Autobots to save Earth from The Fallen, the ruthless robot who teams up with the Decepticons.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible -- Fallout
programme.desc: After a crucial operation goes wrong, IMF Agent Ethan Hunt and his team must work together with a few allies to prevent a nuclear attack.

programme.title: Gods of Egypt
programme.desc: After Set, the Egyptian God of darkness, kills his brother and seizes the throne, he enslaves the kingdom. However, a flawed mortal, Bek, and the God of the sky Horus rise to challenge him.

programme.title: G.I. Joe: The Rise of Cobra
programme.desc: American soldiers Duke and Ripcord survive an attack by arms dealer James McCullen and soon join an elite military team tasked with taking him down for good.

programme.title: Tracers
programme.desc: Cam, a bike messenger, is wanted by the Chinese mafia and he is on the run while learning parkour after crashing into a beautiful woman.
